data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, the strong current accident year performance, offset by the back year reserve strengthening, has resulted in a claims ratio for the Syndicate of 54% for the year (2013: 57%). The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 11.1m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: release of GBP 6.2m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2012 underwriting Year of Account (YOA) of the Syndicate has been reinsured to close into the 2013 YOA of the Syndicate with a total recognised profit of GBP 14.2m, representing an outperformance against plan.
Recognition of the Talisman claim, an emergence of a loss attaching to an historic Year of Account, has been required in the period.
Increased notifications on the New Zealand earthquake claims have required strengthening of reserves on prior years.

Healthcare and Professional Indemnity - particularly the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account, which has required some additional reserve strengthening on the older Years of Account - have proven more problematic.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall back year reserve strengthening in 2014. This was driven by adverse development on specific claims, including the Talisman claim (affecting Marine, Aviation, and Transport lines), increased notifications for New Zealand earthquake claims (Property), and additional strengthening required for older Years of Account in Healthcare and Professional Indemnity lines. These strengthenings offset a GBP 14.2m gross profit (release) recognized from the closure of the 2012 Year of Account, which was primarily due to favorable performance in the MAT division. The net prior year movement resulted in a deterioration of GBP 11.1m.
